bag.help:
Usage: bag [options] [command]

Scaffold, run, deploy, and monetize a single seller agent on BNB Chain.

Options:
  --version              output the version number
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  init [options] <name>  Create a new bnbagent-studio seller agent project.
  dev [options]          Run the Agent locally.
  deploy [options]       Deploy the agent after explicitly selecting a provider
                         (bnb|aws|azure); lifecycle subcommands inspect recorded
                         deployments.
  scan [options]         Detect project framework + manifest (read-only).
  skills                 Install Claude Code skills into the host IDE.
  recipe                 Print recipe code/files (agent / wallet / 8004).
  agents                 Local agent project registry
                         (~/.bnbagent-studio/projects.toml).
  config                 Read / write studio.toml.
  env                    Edit project .env.local idempotently.
  budget                 Opt-in auto-topup policy for Pieverse LLM.
  audit                  View on-chain action audit log.
  wallet                 Wallet keystore helpers (create / list / inspect).
  erc8004                ERC-8004 identity (register / show / resolve /
                         update-endpoint / update-metadata / get-metadata /
                         clear-pending).
  erc8183                ERC-8183 commerce (list / buy / status / submit / fetch
                         / settle).
  x402                   x402 payment client helpers.
  mpp                    Native MPP+B402 payment client helpers.
  llm                    LLM provider helpers (test / inspect).
  doctor [options]       Diagnose project + environment.
  platform               Managed-platform account ops (login / logout / whoami /
                         agents / credit / token), delegated to the pinned
                         bnbagent deploy CLI.
  bundle [options]       Bundle a seller workspace + pinned SDK/runtime tarballs
                         for handoff.
  help [command]         display help for command

bag budget.help:
Usage: bag budget [options] [command]

Opt-in auto-topup policy for Pieverse LLM.

Options:
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  show [options]     Print current [budget] policy.
  enable [options]   Enable auto-topup (writes [budget].enabled = true).
  disable [options]  Disable auto-topup (writes [budget].enabled = false).

bag config.help:
Usage: bag config [options] [command]

Read / write studio.toml.

Options:

bag deploy.help:
Usage: bag deploy [options] [command]

Deploy the agent after explicitly selecting a provider (bnb|aws|azure);
lifecycle subcommands inspect recorded deployments.

Options:
  --provider <provider>               Provider: bnb|aws|azure. Required for
                                      non-interactive deploy; lifecycle commands
                                      need it only when multiple records exist.
  --backend <backend>                 Managed backend confirmation for
                                      --provider bnb (aws or azure). It must
                                      match [stack].runtime. (choices: "aws",
                                      "azure")
  --project-root <path>               Override project root.
  --skip-prepare                      Skip non-storage local readiness checks.
  --force-deploy-broken-storage       DANGEROUS: bypass fatal
                                      deliverable-storage checks.
  --force                             Bypass explicitly forceable readiness
                                      checks.
  --secrets-mode <mode>               Runtime secret delivery mode. (choices:
                                      "secretsmanager", "envvars", default:
                                      "secretsmanager")
  --accept-risk                       Accept provider risk/terms disclosures.
  --yes                               Confirm the selected deployment plan
                                      non-interactively.
  --allow-multiple                    Allow creating a deployment while another
                                      provider remains active.
  --skip-smoke                        Skip the delegated post-deploy smoke
                                      check.
  -h, --help                          display help for command

Commands:
  prepare [options]                   Run the deploy-readiness sweep on this
                                      project.
  agent [options] [agentcoreArgs...]  Deprecated compatibility alias for `bag
                                      deploy`. Thin wrapper: gates on prepare,
                                      syncs runtime secrets, builds the agent
                                      (`pnpm build`), delegates to the platform
                                      CLI.
  verify [options]                    Probe a deployed endpoint + reconcile
                                      ERC-8004 identity.
  status [options]                    Report recorded deploy state + best-effort
                                      liveness (read-only).
  info [options]                      Show the buyer-access surface for a
                                      platform or Azure self-deploy.
  destroy [options]                   Print a teardown plan (default dry-run);
                                      --execute tears down the agent (AgentCore
                                      runtime + runtime secret + recorded
                                      state).
  logs [options]                      Show the selected deployment's logs via
                                      bnbagent-deploy.
  fix-gitignore [options]             Ensure the workspace .gitignore excludes
                                      .studio/ (the agent's .env.local +
                                      keystore).

bag erc8004.help:
Usage: bag erc8004 [options] [command]

ERC-8004 identity (register / show / resolve / update-endpoint / update-metadata
/ get-metadata / clear-pending).

Options:
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  register [options]            Register this wallet as an ERC-8004 agent.
  show [options]                Show this wallet's on-chain agent record.
  resolve [options] <agent_id>  Resolve an agent_id to its agentURI.
  update-endpoint [options]     Update this wallet's registered service endpoint
                                on ERC-8004.
  update-metadata [options]     Set an arbitrary metadata key/value on this
                                wallet's ERC-8004 agent.
  get-metadata [options]        Read a metadata value by key from this wallet's
                                ERC-8004 agent.
  clear-pending [options]       Clear stale [identity] pending_* state from
                                studio.toml (e.g. an unverified relay tx that
                                never reached the chain). Refuses when the
                                pending tx is still known to the chain RPC
                                unless --force.

bag erc8004 register.help:
Usage: bag erc8004 register [options]

Register this wallet as an ERC-8004 agent.

Options:
  --endpoint <url>      URL where this agent is reachable. Default: the recorded
                        [identity].endpoint from studio.toml (auto-filled by a
                        successful deploy).
  --agent-uri <uri>     Optional pre-built agent URI.
  --network <name>      Override [network].default (e.g. bsc-mainnet,
                        bsc-testnet).
  --name <name>         Human-readable agent name. (default: "studio-agent")
  --description <text>  Agent description. (default: "bnbagent-studio agent")
  --protocol <name>     Protocol identifier written to services[].name in the
                        ERC-8004 registration JSON. Default: the native protocol
                        derived from the project's studio.toml [stack].protocols
                        (A2A → the agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json;
                        MCP → the MCP server at /mcp), falling back to A2A.
                        ERC8183 remains selectable for back-compat. (choices:
                        "A2A", "MCP", "ERC8183")
  --version <version>   A2A protocol version recorded on the registered endpoint
                        (default: 0.3.0). (default: "0.3.0")
  --no-paymaster        Skip the network's MegaFuel sponsored-gas relay and
                        self-pay gas from the wallet (escape hatch when the
                        relay accepts a tx but never broadcasts it).
  -h, --help            display help for command

bag erc8183 buy.help:
Usage: bag erc8183 buy [options] [task]

Buy a job: create / register / set_budget / fund.

Arguments:
  task                      Task description (or use --task).

Options:
  --provider <address>      Provider wallet address (on-chain only).
  --agent-id <id>           ERC-8004 agent_id (resolves provider + negotiates).
  --task <text>             Task description (alternative to positional).
  --quote-json <json|path>  A seller's signed quote envelope (the negotiate
                            response JSON, inline or a file path) to anchor
                            on-chain. Use with --provider for sellers whose
                            negotiate step ran out-of-band (e.g. an OAuth-gated
                            AgentCore seller).

  --deadline-min <n>        Deadline in minutes (default 30). (default: 30)
  --no-negotiate            Skip /negotiate step (only with --agent-id).
  --protocol <name>         Service name to resolve when using --agent-id
                            (default: ERC8183). (choices: "ERC8183", "A2A",
                            default: "ERC8183")
  --network <name>
  --project-root <path>
  -h, --help                display help for command

bag init.help:
Usage: bag init [options] <name>

Create a new bnbagent-studio seller agent project.

Arguments:
  name                           Project directory name (created in cwd).
                                 Becomes the AgentCore runtime name: ASCII
                                 alphanumerics only, must start with a letter,
                                 ≤23 chars. Names with '-'/'_'/'.' are rejected
                                 (not auto-renamed).

Options:
  --runtime <name>               Runtime scaffold (agentcore, azure-foundry);
                                 Azure: bag deploy --provider azure. (default:
                                 "agentcore")
  --azure-account <name>         Azure Foundry account/resource-name seed
                                 (azure-foundry only).
  --azure-project <name>         Azure Foundry project name (azure-foundry
                                 only).
  --destination <dest>           Where the agent deploys; recorded in
                                 studio.toml [deploy].destination (default:
                                 platform while the trial campaign runs; self
                                 once it has ended, or when a non-agentcore
                                 --runtime or --network bsc-mainnet is passed).
                                 'platform' is a 48h testnet trial on the BNB
                                 Chain managed platform (requires
                                 runtime=agentcore and forces bsc-testnet; a
                                 trial wallet key is transmitted to the operator
                                 — run `bag wallet new` for a throwaway). 'self'
                                 deploys to YOUR own cloud. (choices: "self",
                                 "platform")
  --platform-artifact <kind>     (--destination platform only) Artifact channel
                                 the managed platform ships. evm-local DEFAULTS
                                 to 'zip'; twak MUST be 'container'. Recorded in
                                 studio.toml [deploy].platform_artifact.
                                 (choices: "zip", "container")
  --protocols <faces>            Comma-separated public faces to expose;
                                 recorded in studio.toml [stack].protocols. Any
                                 non-empty combination of A2A, MCP and one B402
                                 payment face (X402 or MPP; default: A2A,X402).
  --payment-protocol <protocol>  B402 HTTP protocol adapter: x402 or mpp
                                 (default: x402). The two are alternatives.
                                 (choices: "x402", "mpp")
  --protocol <protocol>          Legacy single-face alias for --protocols <one>.
  --rails <rails>                Commerce rail(s) to scaffold: 8183, b402, or
                                 both (default). (choices: "8183", "b402",
                                 "both")
  --erc8183-price <base-units>   ERC-8183 list price as a non-negative integer
                                 string in token base units. Use 0 for FREE.
                                 Default: 100000000000000000 (0.1 U).
  --b402-price <usd>             B402 per-request price for x402 or MPP as a
                                 non-negative decimal USD string. Use 0 for FREE
                                 passthrough (no B402 verify/settle). Default:
                                 0.01.
  --llm-provider <provider>      LLM provider to write into studio.toml
                                 [llm].provider. (choices: "openrouter",
                                 "openai", "anthropic", "bedrock",
                                 "pieverse-llm", default: "pieverse-llm")
  --model <id>                   Model id to write into studio.toml [llm].model.
                                 Default: the provider's default (pieverse-llm →
                                 'auto/free', Free at $0/token). Omit to be
                                 prompted from the live Pieverse catalogue (TTY
                                 onboarding).
  --network <name>               Default network to write into studio.toml
                                 [network].default. (choices: "bsc-testnet",
                                 "bsc-mainnet", default: "bsc-testnet")
  --wallet-kind <kind>           Wallet backend for the Agent (default:
                                 evm-local = encrypted local keystore at the
                                 workspace root .studio/wallets/; CodeZip
                                 deploy). altana — encrypted local admin
                                 keystore plus a bounded runtime session;
                                 deploys ship ONLY the session (ALTANA_SESSION
                                 secret). twak — FULLY SUPPORTED, opt in: Trust
                                 Wallet Agent Kit CLI, self-custody encrypted
                                 mnemonic in a PROJECT-DEDICATED home
                                 (.studio/twak); deploys as a container image.
                                 turnkey — remote signer: the key lives in
                                 Turnkey's AWS Nitro enclave and the Agent signs
                                 via TURNKEY_* API credentials; CodeZip deploy;
                                 every successful signature is billed. (choices:
                                 "twak", "evm-local", "altana", "turnkey")
  --twak-home <path>             twak only: point this project at an EXISTING
                                 twak wallet home (the HOME-STYLE PARENT dir
                                 that contains .twak/wallet.json — NOT the .twak
                                 dir itself; a .twak path holding a wallet is
                                 auto-corrected to its parent) instead of the
                                 dedicated .studio/twak. Written to
                                 [wallet].twak_home.
  --storage-provider <kind>      Where job deliverables are stored: 'local'
                                 (default; offline dev) or durable self-hosted
                                 BYOS via 'ipfs', 's3', or 'azure-blob'.
                                 Self-hosted S3/Blob need the user's storage
                                 config and namespaced runtime credentials;
                                 Platform ignores this deploy-time choice and
                                 injects scoped access to managed S3 or Azure
                                 Blob. Written to studio.toml [storage].kind.
                                 (choices: "ipfs", "s3", "azure-blob", "local",
                                 default: "local")
  --ipfs-key <key>               IPFS pinning-service write key/JWT for
                                 --storage-provider ipfs. Written to
                                 .studio/.env.local as STORAGE_API_KEY.
  --force                        Overwrite the target directory if it already
                                 exists.
  --enable-auto-topup            Auto-topup: enable (write [budget].enabled=true
                                 + acknowledged_at). Skips the interactive
                                 prompt.
  --no-auto-topup                Auto-topup: explicitly disable (write
                                 [budget].enabled=false + acknowledged_at).
                                 Skips the interactive prompt.
  --no-onboard                   Skip the TTY onboarding step (password prompt +
                                 wallet new + Pieverse activate + faucet hint).
                                 Just scaffold and print the legacy Next-Steps
                                 recipe.
  --no-install                   Skip the dependency install (`pnpm install`).
                                 Use in CI / offline; install manually before
                                 `bag dev`.
  --ide <ide>                    Which IDE(s) get the emitted provider skill:
                                 'claude-code' (.claude/skills/), 'cursor'
                                 (.cursor/rules/), or 'both'. Omit to
                                 auto-detect (falls back to claude-code).
                                 (choices: "claude-code", "cursor", "both")
  -h, --help                     display help for command

bag wallet.help:
Usage: bag wallet [options] [command]

Wallet keystore helpers (create / list / inspect).

Options:
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  new [options]        Create or import a local EVM keystore.
  twak-init [options]  Create the project's twak wallet without YOU typing the
                       password on a command line (wallet.kind=twak): wraps
                       `twak wallet create --no-keychain` reading the password
                       from stdin / a 0600 file / a hidden prompt, seeds the
                       NaaS credentials, then adopts the address like `bag
                       wallet new`. twak requires --password on its own argv, so
                       the value does reach that short-lived child process.
  show [options]       Show the wallet configured in studio.toml.
  list [options]       List keystore addresses under [wallet] keystore_dir.
  sign [options]       Sign an arbitrary message with the loaded wallet.
  balance [options]    Show native (BNB/tBNB) + U balances for the configured
                       network(s).
  policy [options]     Inspect the wallet's SigningPolicy (read-only).
  session              Manage the bounded Altana session used by the Agent.
  help [command]       display help for command

bag wallet new.help:
Usage: bag wallet new [options]

Create or import a local EVM keystore.

Options:
  --private-key [value]  Import an existing private key. Use the flag alone for
                         a hidden prompt, or `-` to read from stdin; passing the
                         key inline is refused (it leaks to shell history).
  --keystore-dir <path>  Override keystore directory (default: .studio/wallets
                         relative to cwd).
  --project-root <path>  Override project root.
  -h, --help             display help for command

bag x402.help:
Usage: bag x402 [options] [command]

x402 payment client helpers.

Options:
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  quote [options] <url>       Probe an x402-protected URL without paying
                              (returns 402 challenge).
  buy [options] <url>         Pay an x402-protected URL with $U via EIP-3009.
  trust [options] <merchant>  Trust an x402 merchant: probe its live 402,
                              confirm payTo + price, write
                              [payments.x402.merchants.<name>] to studio.toml.
  sell                        Configure and inspect the B402-backed x402 seller
                              rail.

custody: Only `--provider bnb` with a local wallet transmits a signing key to the vendor, and its own consent gate says so: a testnet-scoped key sent to the operator's managed secret channel, reclaimed at 48h. `--destination self` with `--provider aws|azure` deploys to your own cloud and your own Secrets Manager, and `--wallet-kind turnkey` or `altana` never moves a signing key at all. An earlier version of this record stated the narrow case as a property of the tool.

package.description: Skills-first toolkit and bag CLI for BNB Chain seller agents: ERC-8004 identity, ERC-8183 escrowed commerce, and x402 payments.
package.name: @bnbagent/studio-cli

subject: BNB Agent Studio

wallet_kinds.altana: a bounded, revocable session travels; the admin keystore and WALLET_PASSWORD never leave the machine
wallet_kinds.evm-local: the encrypted keystore is injected through a Secrets Manager — the operator's on `--provider bnb`, your own on `--provider aws|azure`
wallet_kinds.turnkey: no local key material exists; only TURNKEY_* API credentials move, and the signing key never leaves the enclave
wallet_kinds.twak: self-custody encrypted mnemonic under .studio/twak, deployed as a container

why_not_deployed: This probe installs the CLI and reads its help. It does not deploy, because deploying is a decision about custody and infrastructure rather than a step in a probe.
